description: Z.ai GLM-4.7-Flash 30B MoE via Ollama: fast local agentic/coding model with thinking and tools; text-only.
notes: NOT INSTALLED: pull with `ollama pull glm-4.7-flash`. Download 19GB (29.9B MoE (A3B-class), Q4_K_M default tag), needs ~23GB RAM plus KV cache; fits the 48GB M4 Max. Library context 198K; limit set to 131072 because Ollama sizes context from VRAM (assumes OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH raised). Z.ai/Ollama page: SWE-bench Verified 59.2 (vs 22.0 and 34.0 for the two comparison models), tau2-bench 79.5. Placed between glm-4.5-air (5.2) and glm-4.7 (6.5), minus Q4 penalty. Q4 quantization already accounted for. Latency estimated for M4 Max 48GB by scaling measured gemma4:26b (78 tok/s, ~4B active) by active-weight bytes; not measured. Thinking is on by default: pass think=false for fast answers. Only a 'latest' tag (no size tags). Active params assumed ~3B for latency. Page checked 2026-10-25.
